routes.name: Full balanced theorem replay with independent deterministic core

C9000162.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 162 (Counterexamples to Ryser’s covering conjecture.; papers: Balanced counterexamples to Ryser's conjecture at prime orders; A counterexample to Ryser's covering conjecture; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/162.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_BALANCED.statement: For every sufficiently large prime q there is a finite intersecting (q+1)-partite, (q+1)-uniform hypergraph with exactly q+1 nonisolated vertices in each part and covering number q+1.

C_BALANCED_DET.statement: Valid compatible tuples satisfying occupancy, core concentration, local obstruction and rho*q > 2*(1+B) give the full balanced hypergraph conclusion over every finite field of order at least four.

C_BALANCED_CAND.statement: Independent constituent offsets give the candidate graph bounds and initial occupancy with probability 1-o(1), and distinct pairs jointly with probability exp(-1)+o(1).

C_BALANCED_MOMENT.statement: Uniform conditional pattern-count hypotheses imply bounded moments and centered moments of order O_s(q^s).

C_BALANCED_SELECT.statement: The stated sparse slot graph admits random independent-transversal selection with uniform bounded cylinders and occupancy.

C_BALANCED_TAIL.statement: Slot minimum at least three and maximum degree/minimum slot size at most one eighth imply positive independent-transversal probability and cylinder bound exp(s/2) times the inverse slot sizes.

C_BALANCED_DOM.statement: Conditional on return, the selected three deletion lines per direction have law pointwise dominated by exp(O(q)) times the uniform deletion law.

C_BALANCED_PROFILE.statement: Profile classes satisfying the stated strict visible-mass condition have uniform deletion probability at most exp(-b*q*log(q)).

C_BALANCED_DELETE.statement: Every fixed exp(K*q)-dominated deletion law satisfies the three robust deletion conclusions in thm:deletion.

C_BALANCED_STABLE.statement: The explicit prime-plane almost-cover hypotheses in lem:prime-stability imply a projective pencil of size at least (1-zeta)*q.

C_BALANCED_CORE.statement: In prime planes, small covers of the undeleted core concentrate in a projective pencil with probability tending to one.

C_BALANCED_LOCAL.statement: The selected four-tuples satisfy the local pencil cover obstruction jointly with successful return except with probability o(1).

C_AFFINE_MOMENT.statement: The affine incidence first moment, second moment and directional variance identities of elementary.tex hold over every finite field.

C_DRIFT.statement: The bounded-increment process with predictable drift satisfies the stated fixed-time exponential tail bound.

C_JUMPS.statement: Independent bounded-difference trials give the stated Doob increment, variance and tail bounds.

C_EXT_MAIN.statement: For every sufficiently large prime s congruent to two modulo three, every sufficiently large odd n, with threshold depending on s, admits the asserted unbalanced hypergraph of rank s^n+1.

C_EXT_GADGET.statement: The small-field gadget of lem:gadget satisfies cubic-bijection, five-point occupancy and the weighted line/point cover obstruction.

C_EXT_INC.statement: The proper-subfield condition implies the uniform incidence saving of extension incidence.tex thm:incidence.

C_EXT_ADDITIVE.statement: The extension manuscript's extraction, scalar-covering and approximate-subfield lemmas imply its incidence reduction.

C_EXT_LINE.statement: Independent bounded-shape deletions under the stated survival conditions give occupancy and almost-pencil concentration.

C_EXT_SELECTION.statement: The stated bounded translates and bounded direction multiplicities admit compatible selection from constant-size independent pools with probability tending to one.

C_EXT_DOMCERT.statement: Failure of an independent transversal gives the nonempty-part domination certificate with at most twice the number of parts minus two vertices.

C_EXT_POOL.statement: The extension candidate pools satisfy uniform pencil, survival and five-group bounds with probability tending to one.

C_EXT_INTERSECT.statement: The extension hypergraph is intersecting, its parametrized edges are distinct, and vertex effects on exceptional positions obey con-label-action.

C_EXT_COVER.statement: The infinite, finite-internal and finite-external pencil-center cases exclude all extension hypergraph covers of size at most q.

C_BALANCED_NATIVE.statement: A real native Lean replay certifies the complete balanced main theorem with only the declared foundational axioms.

C_BALANCED_REUSE_HIGH.statement: For a fixed affine point p, successful selection with at least two split lines through p and generator reuse count kappa=4b-|Gamma| at least three has probability O(q^(-3)).

C_BALANCED_REUSE_SMALL.statement: For 3<=b<=ceil(log q), a fixed eligible equality pattern with kappa zero or one, direction assignment and bits, the aligned law has admissible bad-cover probability at most b^O(1)*(2B/q)^(3-kappa).

C_BALANCED_REUSE_TWO.statement: For fixed b, equality pattern with kappa two, and bits, the summed alignment and admissible bad-cover probabilities over eligible direction assignments are at most (q+1)^(5b-2)*q^(-4b)*O(b^3/q).

C_EXT_SUMSET.statement: Finite abelian-group sets satisfy the stated Ruzsa triangle and covering inequalities and, when Y is nonempty and |Y-Y|<=M|Y|, the bound |uY-vY|<=M^(u+v)|Y| for nonnegative integers u,v.

C_EXT_EXTRACTION.statement: For finite A,B subsets of the nonzero elements of a field, G subset A x B, D and J the differences and quotients on G, n>0 and V>=2, the hypotheses |A|,|B|,|D|,|J|<=Vn and |G|>=n^2/V yield S subset A with 3n/(8V^2)<=|S|<=Vn and |S-S|,|S/S|<=2^20*V^22*n.

C_EXT_SCALAR.statement: Under the exact hypotheses of inc-scalar-coverings, every scalar expression of at most m allowed field operations has the stated K^C_m translate covering, where C_0=4 and C_(m+1)=3C_m+5; inversions are restricted to nonzero arguments.

C_EXT_NO_APPROX.statement: Under the proper-subfield bound, no sequence has |S|=q^(1/2+o(1)), K=q^o(1)>=2, and both |S-S| and |S/S| at most K|S|.

C_EXT_MARTINGALE.statement: For M,V,u>0, martingale differences bounded by M with the stated deterministic conditional-variance budget V satisfy the two-sided bound 2*exp(-min(u^2/V,u/M)/4).

C_EXT_PLACEMENT.statement: For an eligible sufficiently large prime s and q=s^n with odd n>=3, the specified small-field direction groups cover every ambient direction once or twice, only groups 1 and star can overlap, conflict-direction multiplicity is at most two, and every proper subfield has order at most q^(1/3).

C_BALANCED_FIDELITY.statement: The full native balanced theorem has the exact manuscript quantifiers and ordinary finite set-hypergraph semantics.

C_BALANCED_431.statement: The universal finite pencil forcing, parallel and all affine-center budget obstructions, together with the partition-to-ordinary-hypergraph encoding and cover equivalence, hold exactly as encoded in Audit162 Main.lean. These are deterministic construction-core theorems, not asymptotic geometric existence.
